description:
From the Gorn and other haunting nightmares aboard the Enterprise to the Borg’s relentless assimilation and the body-snatching terror of “Conspiracy,” the Star Trek universe is no stranger to scary and spooky moments. Relive 31 of the most haunting, unsettling, and downright eerie scenes from the final frontier.

Stream Star Trek on Paramount+. 

Star Trek: The Original Series, Star Trek: The Next Generation, Star Trek: Discovery, Star Trek: Enterprise, Star Trek: Strange New Worlds, Star Trek: Deep Space Nine, Star Trek: Voyager, Star Trek: Picard, Star Trek: Lower Decks.
